desc: Ideation complete: Plan to use monotonic stacks to find previous/next smaller/larger elements and an O(1) formula to count valid subarrays respecting length constraint k.
Implement helper functions to find previous smaller/larger element indices and next smaller/larger element indices using monotonic stacks.
Implement the logic to calculate the number of subarrays where `nums[i]` is the minimum/maximum, respecting the length constraint `k`, using the $O(1)$ formula derived.
Iterate through the array, accumulate the total sum of minimums and maximums.
Return the sum of the two totals.
